Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The defensive-driving page carries a diagram with time bands for search, stopping and following zones and for commercial vehicles; only the rules printed in the text were taught, not the diagram's bands [A01].
The U-turn page repeats the school-zone U-turn rule already taught in the signs section; it is not restated here to avoid a duplicate fact [A05].
The parking page shows a sample time-limit sign with example hours; those sample values are illustrations and were not taught as rules [A07].
Parallel-parking steps refer to lettered pictures; only the written steps were taught, without the pictures [A08].
The no-parking list carries a statute reference; the rules are restated without copying statute text, and the railroad parking distance already taught in the signs section is not repeated.
